notes: Last caption no longer hangs over the ending. Transcribers (Scribe/Whisper) often stretch the final word's end to the end of the audio, so the last caption used to freeze over trailing b-roll / the packshot — and the live preview even forced it to the very end on purpose ('hold last caption to end'). Now the last caption gets only a short readable tail after its last word (capped at ~1.5s), and if a scene cut was placed before the packshot the caption is trimmed to that cut. Preview and render now match. Fix lives in the shared engine (engine/subtitles.py) + preview parity (web/index.html), so it carries into the captions-only build too.
